🚤 Let's be honest and fair: small boat arrivals are DOWN 42% - 18,565 from 1 Jan to 23 Sept 2026 vs 32,188 last year (Home Office).

But 781 people arrived on 10 boats on 23 September alone, and boats are carrying more people each. A smaller number is not a solution. The aim has to be zero.
